abstract: In a vacuum gripper device for lifting and holding workpieces, the valve chamber (4) of a safety valve combined with a rubber-elastic suction cup (1) is designed with a bellows (2) which is prestressed in the closing position of the valve element (9) by a valve spring (12) joined to the valve element (9) counter to the ambient pressure acting on the bellows (2) from outside, the valve seat (13) for the valve element (9) having a formation at the outlet of the vacuum air conduit, where it is connected to the valve chamber (4), for subjecting the valve element (9) to pressure in the same direction as the valve spring (12) using the suction pressure supplied via the vacuum air conduit. <IMAGE>
